projects.hero_model: intent-first chooser as hero, no banner
projects.layout: fixed chooser column + fluid vehicle-first result list
projects.discovery_model: three-step scenario chooser resolving to a re-priced list
projects.type_character: single modern Cyrillic UI face, sentence case, tabular numerals
projects.surface: warm neutral #F5F5F3 page, flat white cards, hairline borders
projects.accent: #FDDD00 restricted to selection, active duration and primary action
projects.imagery: real fleet photography, object-contain on neutral plates
projects.motion: restrained high-damping spring; layout reordering; numeric springs
projects.signature: duration change re-prices the fleet with every figure walking to its new value
projects.price_model: duration-bound hierarchy — total dominant on multi-day, daily rate on one day
notable_constraints: logo and black/yellow/white core locked by client brand brief
yellow sampled from the logo asset rather than chosen
no gradients, no glass, no mono UI labels

anti_repeat_notes: Do not reuse the intent-first chooser-as-hero model on the next project without a distinct justification.
Onest + custom 1.6-stroke domain icons + 20/16/12/8 radius + flat warm-neutral surfaces is now a used combination.
The duration-bound price hierarchy and the numeric-spring signature belong to this project.
Avoid repeating the bottom-tab-bar + quick-preview + chosen-item-bar triad as a default mobile pattern.
